items.title: Dig
items.summary:
A web utility that executes the dig command to query domain records. Can you break out of the command syntax and hijack the shell?
TL;DR Dig is a web security challenge that explores OS Command Injection. The application takes a domain name from a POST parameter and executes system("dig '" . $_POST['name'] . "';") . Because the parameter is placed inside single quotes without proper escaping, an attacker can supply a closing single quote followed by arbitrary shell commands ( '; bash -c "..."; # ) to execute arbitrary commands and retrieve the flag.
